notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.notes:
You can now play through the first 6 levels of the game—that help guide you through some of the level mechanics.

Feedback from players, and the online scoreboard was that the 3rd selectable stage, Maintenance Corridor, was too difficult.

To help you survive, we’ve added the much-requested Medpacks! Healing is finally here, making the notorious Maintenance Corridor of Terror a little more forgiving (but still terrifying 👀).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379409/29333886eb0c8bf158636688d66dd7bd142c6262.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bigger Stages
notes.notes:
Work has been continuing on the main game after the release of the demo. Here are some samples of some of the later stages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379409/c377a4719548b73c949c1deec37231aa01db91c5.jpg[/img]

This is one of the laser gun stages. It's called the danger room and has crates connected to chains that the player can swing on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379409/bc071da3d475dd3b3d4484581585343333e10367.jpg[/img]

This one is the ship's mainframe. I’m planning to add lots of mainframe-style computers and blinking lights. This stage is also filled with Oviraptors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379409/76ec07a479db702d8a8e188118c10ba9236101cf.jpg[/img]

This stage's theme reminds me of a traditional Mario Bros. game. I designed the ship's tiles to mimic an outdoor area so the Pachycephalosaurus pens would feel more like a natural habitat. There's meant to be real dirt on the floor too, so I'll need to add some dust particle effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379409/ac86e584305aceab2d07b7c523c7b0137f8b54c9.png[/img]

This stage is part one of the boss battle with the Allosaurus. I have the battle mechanics in mind but still need to code them.

I hope you enjoyed the update!

notes.title: 🦖 Demo Available 😃
notes.notes:
Demo Available! 😃

Try three (3) handpicked levels on both normal and hard difficulties in the stealthy release of the Dino Space Station Demo!

🦖 The third stage is longer and more challenging than the first two—don't give up!
🐱 Find the hidden cat in each level!
🏆 Compete for the fastest times on the leaderboards!

🎮 Game Loop:
🔋 Find the battery and place it in the generator to power the exit door and complete the level.

🕹️ Game Actions:
1️⃣ Jump on smaller enemies to squash them and gain a slight bounce.
2️⃣ Use the interact button (default: X on keyboard, West button on gamepad) to toggle switches when power is on.
3️⃣ Press and hold interact to pick up crates. Crates can also be moved by pushing them.
4️⃣ No laser rifle in this demo—you cannot fire.

Have fun! 🚀😃

notes.title: Announcing Dino Space Station
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379409/f40a5f3eda5422a62ba051f794bde3e0b7299171.gif[/img]

Dino Space Station is a 2D pixel art platformer. Restore power. Evade dinosaurs. Escape the wreckage. A meteor shower has wrecked a station full of resurrected dinosaurs. Navigate dark, perilous corridors, dodge raptors, and survive. Warning: Gameplay maybe anxiety-inducing.

Features:

Over 30 stages with powered off/powered on cycle.
Pixelated Dinosaurs - Compsognathus, Pachycephalosaurus, Velociraptor, Oviraptor, Pterodactyl, Dilophosaurus and more.
Replay value options such as stage speedrun times and finding hidden collectables.
Gamepad optimised gameplay.


***Fun Fact***

The pixel art and animations for the Dinosaurs were created by my son Leo, during his school holidays when he was bored and wanted to help dad make a video game.

Leo also has a Lego Stop Motion Youtube channel and his audience was one of the target persona’s used in creating the game.
